title: Pressure control by box size (control-p abc and control-p a)
purpose: Exercises the `control-p` option of the `epsr` engine [@soper1996,@soper2005,@epsrmanual], which adjusts the simulation box after every EP iteration to drive the computed pressure towards a requested value. Two runs in one folder test isotropic scaling of all three axes and scaling of only the a axis, which makes the box non-cubic.
fortran: `epsr_standalone_rev3.f`: `runepsr17` (`control-p` parsing, "Adjust boxsize to control pressure" block), `uniform` (`ycoh` recomputed)
`ato_read_and_save.f`: `minitc` (general-cell branch when the 9-number box header is read back)
system: The EPSR-test system: a liquid mixture of 200 dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO, (CH3)2SO) and 400 water molecules (DMSO mole fraction 1/3; 3200 atoms) at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å (atomic number density 0.0881 atoms/Å³). DMSO uses EPSR's Lennard-Jones + Coulomb reference potential with methyl rotational groups; water uses SPC/E Lennard-Jones and charge parameters [@berendsen1987] with EPSR's flexible intramolecular geometry (O-H 0.976 Å). The empirical potential is refined against three neutron diffraction data sets of deuterated DMSO in D2O, in null-scattering H2O/D2O and in H2O (ISIS SANDALS runs SLS03863, SLS03871, SLS03850), the isotope-substitution approach of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. The virial pressure `pressd` computed by `press` [@allentildesley1987] gives `rat = 0.01*clip(pressd - 0, ±1)`; the scaled axes are multiplied by `(1+rat)**(1/naxes)`, molecule centres are transformed through fractional coordinates of the old cell, and `dmax`/`cell` are reset to the smallest perpendicular face distance.
inputs: `scripts/make_inputs.sh`: in the EPSR-test `.EPSR.inp` `control-p abc 0.0 0.01`, `ntimes 2`, `niter 2`; `scripts/clone_run.py boxa "control-p a 0.0 0.01"` makes a second run `boxa` with the same files. `commands.txt`: both runs, `repeat 2`.
verification: Four iterations per run (2 passes × `niter 2`). In the stored Fortran reference the cubic run grows from 33.1213 to 33.4521 Å; in `boxa` only a changes (34.3514 × 33.1213 × 33.1213 Å), the `.ato` is written with the general-cell header and read back in pass 2. The README reports gcov evidence that the `dmaxfac`, `change_boxsize` and `uniform` lines run in every iteration. Both runs' outputs are identical in both passes.
notes: Reproduced: `rho` and `xstar` are not recomputed after a box change (so `uniform` gives the same `ycoh`); phix/phiy/phiz of all molecules are transformed; the keyword `ca` is accepted but selects no axis and `ac` is rejected.
